stem: A cart is routinely moved from waste handling into propagation without a sanitation step. What is the primary biosecurity concern?
choices: The cart may carry contaminants from a higher-risk zone into a cleaner production zone
The cart may wear out faster on smoother floors
The cart will change propagation humidity
The cart is unsafe unless painted a different color
rationale: Equipment movement can connect zones intended to remain separated. Defined sanitation or dedicated equipment reduces that pathway.
